二.exen: My family lives on the second floor.

八.ex: 我给妈妈买了八个苹果。
八.exen: I bought eight apples for my mother.

十.exen: There are ten students in our class.

是.note:
Links two nouns that are the same thing: 他是老师 = he is a teacher.
Do not use it with an adjective. "He is happy" is 他很高兴 — 他是高兴 is wrong.
Negative is 不是: 我不是学生.
Also how you agree: 是 on its own means "that is right".

坐.exen: You sit here and I'll sit there.

桌子.ex: 我们的桌子上有很多水果。
桌子.exen: There is a lot of fruit on our table.

想.exen: Today I want to go home a bit early.

不.exen: I'm not going to school today.
不.note:
Refuses or denies, generally or in the future: 我不去 = I am not going. 我不喜欢 = I do not like it.
For something that did not happen, use 没: 我没去 = I did not go.
And the negative of 有 is always 没有 — 不有 is wrong.

多.ex: 这个月我学了很多新汉字。
多.exen: I learned a lot of new characters this month.

九.ex: 他九点准时来公司上班。
九.exen: He gets to the office at nine, right on time.

朋友.ex: 我的朋友今天来我家吃饭。
朋友.exen: My friend is coming to my home for dinner today.

三.ex: 妈妈买了三斤香蕉回家。
三.exen: Mum bought three jin of bananas and brought them home.

同学.ex: 我和同学一起去图书馆写作业。
同学.exen: My classmate and I go to the library to do homework.

吗.note:
Turns a statement into a yes/no question. Nothing else changes — same word order, no rising tone needed.
你有课。→ 你有课吗？
他是老师。→ 他是老师吗？
Chinese has no word for yes or no. You answer by repeating the verb: 有 / 没有, 是 / 不是.
Never use 吗 with a question word. 你去哪儿？already asks — 你去哪儿吗？is wrong.

呢.note:
Throws the same question back, without repeating it.
我很好，你呢？= I am fine, and you?
On its own after a noun it asks where something is: 我的书呢？= where is my book?
It never asks a yes/no question — that is 吗. 你好吗？asks; 你呢？only follows.

的.note:
Joins two things, with the owner or the description first.
我的书 = my book. 老师的名字 = the teacher’s name.
红色的车 = a red car. 很贵的房子 = an expensive house.
With family and things close to you, people usually drop it: 我妈妈, 我家 — not 我的妈妈.

了.note:
After the verb, it says the action already happened.
我吃饭。→ 我吃饭了。= I have eaten.
At the end of a sentence it can instead mean something has changed: 下雨了 = it has started raining.
It is not a past tense. 明天我就走了 uses 了 about tomorrow.
The negative drops it: 我没吃饭, never 我没吃饭了.

很.note:
A Chinese adjective is already a whole sentence, but it sounds unfinished standing alone — 很 fills that gap.
他高兴 sounds cut off. 他很高兴 is the ordinary way to say "he is happy".
So 很 is usually not "very" at all. For real emphasis say 非常 or stress the word.
No 是 in front of it: 他很高兴, never 他是很高兴.

在.note:
Says where something is: 我在学校 = I am at school.
Before a verb it says the action is happening right now: 我在吃饭 = I am eating.
The place comes before the verb, not after: 我在家吃饭 — 我吃饭在家 is wrong.
Negative is 不在: 他不在.

有.note:
Owning: 我有一本书 = I have a book.
Existing, with the place first: 桌子上有一个苹果 = there is an apple on the table.
Its negative is 没有 — 不有 does not exist.
How many? 你有几个孩子？

会.note:
For something you learned to do: 我会游泳 = I can swim, because I was taught.
Also for what is likely: 明天会下雨 = it will probably rain tomorrow.
Negative is 不会: 我不会说法语.
Compare 能 — that one is about this moment, not about the skill.

能.note:
For being able right now: 我能来 = I can come, nothing is stopping me.
Also for permission: 这里能抽烟吗？= can I smoke here?
Compare 会: someone who never learned to swim says 我不会游泳; someone who learned but has a cold today says 我今天不能游泳.

都.note:
Means every one of them, and sits before the verb: 我们都是学生.
都我们是学生 is wrong — it never goes first.
It looks backwards, at what came before it: 他们都来了 = all of them came.
With 不, position changes the meaning: 都不去 = none of us go; 不都去 = not all of us go.

和.note:
Joins two nouns: 我和你 = you and me. 茶和咖啡 = tea and coffee.
It does not join two sentences. English "I ate and then left" becomes two clauses side by side in Chinese, with no 和.
It also means "with": 我和朋友一起去 = I am going with a friend.

没有.note:
Says you do not have it: 我没有钱 = I have no money.
Or that it did not happen: 我没有去 = I did not go. Often shortened to 没: 我没去.
The verb keeps no 了 after 没: 我没吃 — not 我没吃了.

个.note:
Chinese puts a counting word between the number and the thing: 一个人, 三个苹果.
个 is the general one and fits most things a beginner meets.
You cannot leave it out: 一人 is wrong, 一个人 is right.
It also goes after 这 and 那: 这个, 那个.

块.note:
The everyday word for money, the one people actually say out loud: 十块 = ten yuan.
多少钱？— 三十块。
The written form on receipts and prices is 元.

些.note:
More than one, without saying how many. It never stands alone.
一些书 = some books. 这些人 = these people. 那些 = those.
Not with a number: 三些 is wrong.

一点儿.note:
A small amount of something: 一点儿水 = a little water.
After an adjective it asks for a bit more or less: 便宜一点儿 = a bit cheaper.
Do not confuse it with 有点儿, which goes before an adjective and complains: 有点儿贵 = a bit too expensive.

太.note:
More than is good, not simply "very": 太贵了 = too expensive.
It almost always ends with 了.
Said about something you like, it becomes praise: 太好了！= that is wonderful.

几.note: Asks how many, when the answer is a small number. 几个人？= how many people?

多少.note: Asks how many or how much, when the answer could be large. 多少钱？= how much money?

怎么样.note: Asks what something is like, or suggests something. 这个菜怎么样？= how is this dish?

哪.note: Asks which one out of several. 哪个是你的？= which one is yours?

哪儿.note: Asks where. 你去哪儿？= where are you going?

什么.note: Asks what. 这是什么？= what is this? It stays where the answer would go, not at the front.

谁.note: Asks who. 他是谁？= who is he?

怎么.note: Asks how something is done. 怎么去？= how do we get there?

这.note: Points at something near you. 这个 = this one.

那.note: Points at something further away. 那个 = that one.

时候.note: Means a point in time, and almost always comes with another word: 什么时候 = when?

累.ex: 今天爬了很多楼梯，我很累。
累.exen: I climbed a lot of stairs today, so I'm very tired.

零.ex: 我的电话号码里有两个零。
零.exen: There are two zeros in my phone number.

早上.exen: In the morning I run in the park.

走.exen: He walks to work every day.

晴.ex: 今天是晴天，我想去公园。
晴.exen: It's sunny today, so I'd like to go to the park.

阴.ex: 今天是阴天，天气有点儿冷。
阴.exen: It's cloudy today and a bit cold.

第一.ex: 这次考试他考了第一名。
第一.exen: He came first in this exam.

弟弟.ex: 我弟弟今天帮妈妈买菜。
弟弟.exen: My younger brother helped Mum buy groceries today.

打篮球.ex: 放学后，我们去操场打篮球。
打篮球.exen: After school we go to the playground to play basketball.

忙.ex: 妈妈今天上班一直很忙。
忙.exen: Mum was busy at work all day today.

踢足球.ex: 放学后，哥哥去公园踢足球。
踢足球.exen: After school my older brother goes to the park to play football.

也.ex: 我买了苹果，也买了香蕉。
也.exen: I bought apples, and bananas too.

吧.exen: Let us go and eat together.
吧.note:
At the end of a sentence it turns a statement into a suggestion: 我们走吧 = let's go.
After a guess it asks you to agree: 你是老师吧？= you're a teacher, right?
Without it, 我们走 only says we are going — 吧 is what makes it an invitation.

对.ex: 你的答案是对的，老师给了满分。
对.exen: Your answer is right, and the teacher gave you full marks.

得.note:
Links a verb to how well or how much it is done: 他跑得很快 = he runs fast.
The verb comes first, then 得, then the description: 你说得很好 = you speak well.
With an object, say the verb twice: 他说汉语说得很好.
It sounds like 的 and 地 — 得 is the one that comes after a verb.

过.note:
After a verb, it says you have done it at some point before: 我去过北京 = I have been to Beijing.
It is about experience, not about when: 你吃过饺子吗？= have you ever had dumplings?
The negative is 没…过: 我没去过.

着.note:
After a verb, it says a state is carrying on: 门开着 = the door is open.
他笑着说 = he said it smiling — one thing going on while another happens.
For an action in progress, 在 is more usual: 他在吃饭.

文化.ex: 中国文化有几千年的历史，值得慢慢了解。
文化.exen: Chinese culture goes back thousands of years and is worth getting to know slowly.

只.exen: We keep three kittens at home.

老.ex: 这只狗已经很老了，走得很慢。
老.exen: This dog is already very old and walks slowly.

西.ex: 傍晚的时候，太阳从西边落下去。
西.exen: At dusk the sun goes down in the west.

东.ex: 早上太阳从东边升起来。
东.exen: In the morning the sun rises in the east.

作用.ex: 阳光对植物的生长有很大的作用。
作用.exen: Sunlight has a big effect on how plants grow.

脚.ex: 走了一天路，我的脚有点儿疼。
脚.exen: After walking all day my feet ache a little.

腿.ex: 爬完山以后，我的腿很疼。
腿.exen: After climbing the mountain my legs really hurt.

耳朵.exen: A rabbit's ears are long and white.

经理.ex: 经理今天在会议上说了明年的计划。
经理.exen: The manager talked about next year's plan at today's meeting.

难.ex: 这道题太难了，我想了半天也没做出来。
难.exen: This question is too hard; I thought about it for ages and still couldn't solve it.

世界.ex: 我很想去看看外面的世界。
世界.exen: I really want to go and see the world outside.

差.ex: 他这次考试的成绩很差，打算下次好好准备。
差.exen: His marks in this exam were poor, so he plans to prepare properly next time.

长.ex: 弟弟今年长得特别快，已经比我高了。
长.exen: My younger brother has grown fast this year and is already taller than me.

邻居.ex: 楼下邻居早上送来了一盘饺子。
邻居.exen: The neighbour downstairs brought up a plate of dumplings this morning.

盘子.ex: 盘子太烫了，别用手直接拿。
盘子.exen: The plate is too hot, so don't pick it up with your bare hands.

同事.ex: 同事帮我把文件送到办公室。
同事.exen: A colleague took the documents to the office for me.

碗.ex: 妈妈把热汤倒进碗里给我喝。
碗.exen: Mum poured the hot soup into a bowl for me.

先.ex: 你先洗手，再来吃晚饭吧。
先.exen: Wash your hands first, then come and have dinner.

校长.ex: 今天校长来教室看我们上课。
校长.exen: Today the principal came to our classroom to watch us in class.

重要.ex: 按时交作业对学生很重要。
重要.exen: Handing homework in on time matters a lot for students.

自己.ex: 你自己收拾书包，别让妈妈帮忙。
自己.exen: Pack your own school bag; don't get Mum to do it.

啊.note:
At the end of a sentence it adds feeling — warmth, surprise, emphasis: 好啊！= sure!
今天好热啊 = it's so hot today!
It changes the tone, not the meaning: take it away and the sentence says the same thing.

把.note:
Brings the object in front of the verb, to say what was done to it: 我把书放在桌子上 = I put the book on the table.
The order is: who + 把 + what + verb + what happened to it.
The verb cannot end the sentence on its own: 我把门关 is unfinished; 我把门关上了 is right.

被.note:
Makes the sentence passive — what it happened to comes first: 我的手机被偷了 = my phone was stolen.
Who did it goes after 被: 蛋糕被弟弟吃了 = the cake was eaten by my little brother.
Mostly used for things that went wrong.

地.note:
Turns a description into how an action is done, right before the verb: 他高兴地说 = he said happily.
The order is description + 地 + verb: 慢慢地走 = walk slowly.
It sounds like 的 and 得 — 地 is the one that comes before a verb.

过.note:
After a verb, it says you have done it at some point before: 我去过北京 = I have been to Beijing.
It is about experience, not about when: 你吃过饺子吗？= have you ever had dumplings?
The negative is 没…过: 我没去过.

带.en: to bring; to take; to carry

放.en: to put; to place; to let go

笨.ex: 这个办法太笨了，大家听完都笑了。
笨.exen: That idea was so clumsy that everyone laughed when they heard it.

合格.ex: 这次的作业终于合格了，老师还写了几句鼓励的话。
合格.exen: This time the homework finally passed, and the teacher wrote a few encouraging words.

困难.ex: 刚来的时候，我在生活上遇到了不少困难。
困难.exen: When I first arrived I ran into quite a few difficulties in daily life.

辣.ex: 这碗面太辣了，我喝了半杯水才好一点。
辣.exen: This bowl of noodles was so spicy that I drank half a glass of water before it eased.

厉害.ex: 他的中文很厉害，很多中国朋友都以为他在中国住过。
厉害.exen: His Chinese is impressive; many Chinese friends assume he has lived in China.

网站.ex: 这个网站上有很多免费的中文课文和练习。
网站.exen: This website has plenty of free Chinese texts and exercises.

无.ex: 这家旅馆的房间都是无烟房间，带孩子来住也放心。
无.exen: All the rooms in this hotel are non-smoking, so it's fine to stay with children.

详细.ex: 请老师把作业的要求写得详细一些。
详细.exen: Please ask the teacher to write the homework requirements out in more detail.

自然.ex: 山里空气很好，我很喜欢这种自然的环境。
自然.exen: The air in the mountains is good; I love this kind of natural setting.

自信.ex: 他说话很自信，大家都愿意听他的意见。
自信.exen: He speaks with confidence, so everyone is willing to hear his views.

著名.ex: 这位著名的作家下个月要来我们学校演讲。
著名.exen: This famous writer is coming to give a talk at our school next month.

作用.ex: 老师的鼓励对他起了很大的作用。
作用.exen: The teacher's encouragement had a big effect on him.

作家.ex: 这位作家写的小说很受年轻人欢迎。
作家.exen: The novels this writer produces are popular with young people.

永远.ex: 我永远不会忘记老师对我的帮助。
永远.exen: I will never forget the help my teacher gave me.

社会.ex: 大学毕业走进社会以后，他学会了很多新东西。
社会.exen: After graduating and entering society, he learned a great deal.

热闹.ex: 晚上的夜市很热闹，很多人在那儿吃小吃。
热闹.exen: The night market is lively in the evening, with lots of people eating street food.

推.ex: 这扇门要往里推，不要用力拉。
推.exen: This door has to be pushed inwards, not pulled.

看法.ex: 关于这个问题，每个人都有不同的看法，我们应该多听听别人的意见。
看法.exen: Everyone sees this question differently, so we should listen to other people's views.

干.ex: 衣服还没干，先别收起来。
干.exen: The clothes aren't dry yet, so don't take them in.

餐厅.ex: 下课后，我们一起去餐厅吃饭。
餐厅.exen: After class we go to the cafeteria to eat together.

厕所.exen: Excuse me, which way is the toilet?

厨房.ex: 妈妈正在厨房里做晚饭。
厨房.exen: Mum is in the kitchen making dinner.

大使馆.ex: 他明天要去大使馆办签证。
大使馆.exen: He's going to the embassy tomorrow to sort out a visa.

地点.ex: 老师告诉我们集合地点在校门口。
地点.exen: The teacher told us the meeting place is the school gate.

地址.ex: 请把你的新地址发给我。
地址.exen: Please send me your new address.

合适.ex: 这双鞋很合适，走路不累。
合适.exen: These shoes fit well, and walking in them isn't tiring.

活泼.ex: 妹妹很活泼，见到客人就笑。
活泼.exen: My little sister is lively and smiles as soon as she sees a guest.

积极.ex: 小王上课很积极，常常回答问题。
积极.exen: Xiao Wang takes an active part in class and often answers questions.

加油站.ex: 爸爸在加油站给车加满油。
加油站.exen: Dad filled the car up at the petrol station.

郊区.ex: 我们周末去郊区看朋友。
郊区.exen: At the weekend we go out to the suburbs to see a friend.

紧张.ex: 考试前，我紧张得睡不着。
紧张.exen: Before the exam I was too nervous to sleep.

精彩.ex: 昨晚的节目很精彩，全家都喜欢。
精彩.exen: Last night's show was wonderful; the whole family enjoyed it.

可怜.ex: 这只小猫在门口淋雨，真可怜。
可怜.exen: This kitten is out in the rain by the door, poor thing.

苦.ex: 妈妈煮的药太苦了，我喝不下。
苦.exen: The medicine Mum brewed is too bitter for me to get down.

困.ex: 下午开会太久，我坐着就困了。
困.exen: The afternoon meeting ran so long that I got sleepy just sitting there.

懒.ex: 天气一热，他就懒得出门了。
懒.exen: As soon as it gets hot he can't be bothered going out.

浪漫.ex: 他们在海边看日落，很浪漫。
浪漫.exen: They watched the sunset by the sea, which was very romantic.

冷静.ex: 考试时先冷静，再慢慢做题。
冷静.exen: In an exam, calm down first and then work through the questions.

凉快.ex: 秋天的晚上打开窗户真凉快。
凉快.exen: Opening the window on an autumn evening is really pleasantly cool.

流利.ex: 她在会议上用中文说得很流利。
流利.exen: She spoke fluent Chinese at the meeting.

乱.ex: 弟弟把书桌上的东西弄得很乱。
乱.exen: My younger brother left everything on the desk in a mess.

麻烦.ex: 搬家时没有电梯，搬家具很麻烦。
麻烦.exen: With no lift on moving day, shifting the furniture was a real hassle.

马虎.ex: 他写作业太马虎，常常看错题目。
马虎.exen: He is careless with his homework and often misreads the questions.

满.ex: 妈妈把购物袋装得满满的。
满.exen: Mum packed the shopping bag completely full.

美丽.ex: 山上的湖水很美丽，吸引了游客。
美丽.exen: The lake up the mountain is beautiful and draws visitors.

免费.ex: 今天超市有免费的试吃活动。
免费.exen: The supermarket has free tastings today.

难受.ex: 我今天头很疼，坐车也难受。
难受.exen: My head aches today, and riding in the car feels awful too.

暖和.ex: 这件外套很暖和，冬天穿正好。
暖和.exen: This coat is warm, just right for winter.

普遍.ex: 学校里用手机查词很普遍。
普遍.exen: Looking words up on a phone is common at school.

轻.ex: 这个书包很轻，孩子背着不累。
轻.exen: This school bag is light, so it isn't tiring for a child to carry.

轻松.ex: 考试结束后，大家都很轻松。
轻松.exen: Once the exam was over, everyone felt relaxed.

穷.ex: 他家以前很穷，买不起新书。
穷.exen: His family used to be poor and couldn't afford new books.

入口.exen: The subway entrance is to the left of the mall.

森林.ex: 周末我们去森林里散步，空气很好。
森林.exen: At the weekend we walk in the forest, where the air is lovely.

伤心.ex: 考试没及格，他在教室里很伤心。
伤心.exen: He failed the exam and sat in the classroom feeling upset.

深.ex: 这口井很深，大家都不敢靠近。
深.exen: This well is deep, and nobody dares go near it.

适合.ex: 这双鞋很适合下雨天穿。
适合.exen: These shoes are well suited to rainy days.

首都.ex: 北京是中国的首都，游客很多。
首都.exen: Beijing is China's capital and gets a lot of visitors.

熟悉.ex: 我对这家超市很熟悉，常去买菜。
熟悉.exen: I know this supermarket well and often shop for groceries there.

帅.ex: 他穿上新衣服后，看起来很帅。
帅.exen: He looked sharp once he put on his new clothes.

酸.ex: 这个苹果有点酸，我想加点糖。
酸.exen: This apple is a bit sour, so I'd like to add some sugar.

随便.ex: 晚饭吃什么都行，你随便选吧。
随便.exen: Anything is fine for dinner, so pick whatever you like.

危险.exen: Cycling too fast in the rain is dangerous.

无聊.ex: 等公交太久，我觉得很无聊。
无聊.exen: Waiting so long for the bus, I got bored.

咸.ex: 这碗汤太咸了，少放点盐。
咸.exen: This soup is too salty; use less salt.

相同.ex: 我和弟弟买了相同的书包。
相同.exen: My younger brother and I bought identical school bags.

香.ex: 妈妈做的米饭很香，大家都爱吃。
香.exen: The rice Mum cooks smells lovely, and everyone enjoys it.

兴奋.ex: 孩子收到生日礼物后兴奋地跳了起来。
兴奋.exen: The child jumped up excitedly on getting the birthday present.

幸福.ex: 一家人晚上一起吃饭让我觉得很幸福。
幸福.exen: Eating together as a family in the evening makes me feel happy.

亚洲.ex: 我第一次去亚洲旅行，认识了很多朋友。
亚洲.exen: On my first trip to Asia I made a lot of friends.

严格.ex: 我们公司的考勤制度很严格，不能迟到。
严格.exen: Our company's attendance rules are strict; you can't be late.

严重.ex: 他的感冒很严重，今天不能去上班。
严重.exen: His cold is bad, so he can't go to work today.

勇敢.ex: 她很勇敢，独自一个人去医院看病。
勇敢.exen: She is brave and went to the hospital on her own.

优秀.ex: 小王的学习成绩很优秀，老师常常表扬他。
优秀.exen: Xiao Wang's marks are excellent, and the teacher often praises him.

幽默.ex: 他的回答很幽默，全班都笑了。
幽默.exen: His answer was funny, and the whole class laughed.

邮局.ex: 我下班后去邮局寄包裹。
邮局.exen: After work I go to the post office to send a parcel.

友好.ex: 新同事很友好，主动帮我找座位。
友好.exen: The new colleague is friendly and helped me find a seat.

有趣.ex: 这本中文书很有趣，我想继续读。
有趣.exen: This Chinese book is interesting, and I want to keep reading.

愉快.ex: 周末和家人吃饭，我很愉快。
愉快.exen: Having a meal with my family at the weekend, I felt cheerful.

真正.ex: 她是真正的朋友，总是帮助我。
真正.exen: She is a true friend and always helps me.

值得.ex: 这家店的面包很好吃，值得再买。
值得.exen: The bread at this shop is delicious and worth buying again.

重.ex: 这个箱子太重了，我搬不动。
重.exen: This box is too heavy for me to lift.

专门.ex: 妈妈专门给我买了新书包。
专门.exen: Mum bought me a new school bag specially.

专业.ex: 姐姐大学学的是中文专业。
专业.exen: My older sister majored in Chinese at university.

准确.ex: 请把你的地址写准确一点。
准确.exen: Please write your address a little more accurately.

准时.ex: 明天上课请大家准时到。
准时.exen: Please everyone arrive on time for class tomorrow.

仔细.ex: 考试前要仔细检查答案。
仔细.exen: Check your answers carefully before the exam.

呀.note:
The same as 啊, after a word that ends in a vowel sound: 是呀！, 你呀！
It adds warmth or surprise: 好漂亮呀 = how pretty!
Leave it out and the meaning is the same, only flatter.

之.note:
The formal, written cousin of 的: 中国之行 = the trip to China.
Mostly met in fixed phrases: 之一 = one of, 之后 = after, 之前 = before, 百分之十 = ten percent.
In everyday speech, use 的.

照.en: according to; to follow (an example); to take (a photo)

羡慕.ex: 我很羡慕他能说这么流利的中文。
羡慕.exen: I really envy how fluently he speaks Chinese.

便.ex: 会议改到楼下举行，以便大家就近参加。
便.exen: The meeting moved downstairs so that everyone could attend close by.

方.ex: 请往前走，银行就在前方路口的右边。
方.exen: Keep walking ahead; the bank is on the right at the crossing in front.

系.ex: 全家的希望都系于他这次考试。
系.exen: The whole family's hopes hang on this exam of his.

官.ex: 他父亲在县里做官，为人一向清正。
官.exen: His father served as an official in the county and was always upright.

丑.ex: 考试作弊是很丑的行为，学校会严肃处理。
丑.exen: Cheating in exams is shameful behaviour, and the school deals with it severely.

哈.ex: 他哈哈大笑，说这个笑话真有意思。
哈.exen: He laughed out loud and said the joke was really funny.

雷.ex: 昨天夜里雷声很大，孩子吓得躲进了被子里。
雷.exen: The thunder was loud last night, and the child hid under the quilt in fright.

锅.ex: 这口锅太旧了，煮饭很容易糊。
锅.exen: This pot is too old, and rice burns in it easily.

夜.ex: 那一夜他都没睡，反复修改自己的方案。
夜.exen: He didn't sleep that night, reworking his proposal over and over.

正.ex: 我正要给你打电话，你就来了。
正.exen: I was just about to call you when you arrived.

个人.ex: 这只是我个人的看法，不代表公司的意见。
个人.exen: This is only my personal view, not the company's position.

欠.ex: 他最近身体欠佳，医生建议他多休息。
欠.exen: His health hasn't been good lately, and the doctor advised more rest.

似的.ex: 他眼睛发亮，兴奋得像刚中了彩票似的。
似的.exen: His eyes lit up, as excited as if he had just won the lottery.

执照.ex: 他考取了驾驶执照，终于可以自己开车上班了。
执照.exen: He got his driving licence and can finally drive himself to work.

意外.ex: 山路上发生了一起意外，好在没有人受伤。
意外.exen: There was an accident on the mountain road, but luckily nobody was hurt.

抓.ex: 公交车门即将关闭时，她一把抓住扶手稳住了身体。
抓.exen: As the bus doors were closing she grabbed the handrail and steadied herself.

等于.ex: 你不说话，就等于同意了。

断.ex: 那根旧绳子承受不住重量，突然断成了两截。
断.exen: The old rope couldn't take the weight and suddenly snapped in two.

家庭.ex: 他有一个温暖的家庭，妻子和孩子都很支持他。
家庭.exen: He has a warm family, and his wife and children are behind him.

良好.ex: 他这学期各科成绩良好，老师很满意。
良好.exen: His marks in every subject were good this term, and the teacher was pleased.

时刻.ex: 那是我人生中最难忘的时刻。
时刻.exen: That was the most unforgettable moment of my life.

赞美.ex: 这首诗赞美了母亲无私的爱。
赞美.exen: This poem praises a mother's selfless love.

成长.ex: 孩子在家庭和学校的共同影响下健康成长。
成长.exen: Children grow up healthily under the joint influence of home and school.

写作.ex: 他大学主修中文，毕业后一直从事写作。
写作.exen: He majored in Chinese at university and has worked at writing ever since.

狮子.ex: 动物园里那只狮子每天清晨都会发出震撼的吼声。
狮子.exen: The lion at the zoo lets out a startling roar every morning.

晕.ex: 坐了六小时长途大巴，他下车时觉得头有点晕。
晕.exen: After six hours on the coach he felt a little dizzy getting off.

多余.ex: 会议材料印了三十份，只来了十二人，剩下的全是多余的。
多余.exen: Thirty copies were printed but only twelve people came, so the rest were surplus.

后果.ex: 他酒后开车，最终造成了严重的后果。
后果.exen: He drove after drinking and in the end caused serious consequences.

风景.ex: 黄山的风景非常美，奇松和云海吸引了无数游客。
风景.exen: The scenery of Huangshan is stunning; its pines and seas of cloud draw countless visitors.

等待.ex: 他在机场等待飞往巴黎的航班起飞。
等待.exen: He waited at the airport for his flight to Paris to take off.

比例.ex: 这个班男生和女生的比例大约是一比二。
比例.exen: The ratio of boys to girls in this class is about one to two.

公元.ex: 这座古城建于公元前二百年，历史十分悠久。
公元.exen: This old city was built in 200 BC and has a very long history.

过分.ex: 他开玩笑开得有点过分，把同学说哭了。
过分.exen: He took the joke too far and made a classmate cry.

目标.ex: 今年我的目标是通过中文考试，并申请海外奖学金。
目标.exen: My goal this year is to pass the Chinese exam and apply for an overseas scholarship.

嗯.ex: “明天去爬山吗？”“嗯，我带水和零食。”
嗯.exen: "Shall we hike tomorrow?" "Mm, I'll bring water and snacks."

模特.ex: 时装周上，各国模特穿着设计师最新的作品走上舞台。
模特.exen: At fashion week, models from many countries took the stage in the designers' latest work.

立即.ex: 医生检查后发现病人血压异常，立即安排他住院。
立即.exen: After the examination the doctor found abnormal blood pressure and admitted him at once.

观念.ex: 随着阅历增长，他对成功的观念慢慢发生了改变。
观念.exen: As his experience grew, his idea of success slowly changed.

思想.ex: 这部纪录片深入探讨了当地人的传统思想和生活方式。
思想.exen: The documentary looks closely at local people's traditional thinking and way of life.

相关.ex: 申请留学签证时，所有相关材料必须在截止日前提交。
相关.exen: When applying for a student visa, all related documents must be submitted before the deadline.

小气.ex: 他连一支笔都不肯借给别人，同学都说他太小气。
小气.exen: He won't even lend a pen, and his classmates all say he is too stingy.

光临.ex: 开业当天，老板站在门口欢迎每一位光临的顾客。
光临.exen: On opening day the owner stood at the door welcoming every customer who came.

下载.ex: 请下载最新版的手机应用，才能使用人脸识别功能。
下载.exen: Please download the latest version of the app to use face recognition.

输入.ex: 请在手机银行里输入六位验证码完成转账。
输入.exen: Enter the six-digit code in mobile banking to complete the transfer.

设计.ex: 团队花了三个月设计一款能识别方言的手机应用界面。
设计.exen: The team spent three months designing an app interface that recognises dialects.

完善.ex: 公司根据用户反馈不断完善这款软件的功能。
完善.exen: The company keeps refining the software's features based on user feedback.

调整.ex: 根据客户反馈，设计团队调整了软件的字体大小和按钮位置。
调整.exen: Following client feedback, the design team adjusted the font size and button positions.

日常.ex: 她用手机软件记录日常饮食和运动数据，已坚持两年。
日常.exen: She has used a phone app to log her daily food and exercise for two years.

日历.ex: 办公室墙上挂着印有公司名字的精美日历。
日历.exen: A handsome calendar printed with the company name hangs on the office wall.

握手.ex: 会议开始前，两位经理热情地握手。
握手.exen: Before the meeting the two managers shook hands warmly.

转告.ex: 老师让我转告班长，明天早上的会议改到第二会议室举行。
转告.exen: The teacher asked me to tell the class monitor that tomorrow morning's meeting moves to the second meeting room.

诊断.ex: 医生结合检查结果和症状，最终诊断他患上了早期肺炎。
诊断.exen: Weighing the test results against the symptoms, the doctor diagnosed early pneumonia.

一律.ex: 所有参赛作品一律不得使用人工智能生成的内容。
一律.exen: No entry may use content generated by artificial intelligence, without exception.

超级.ex: 这家餐厅的食材超级新鲜，寿司很受顾客欢迎。
超级.exen: The ingredients at this restaurant are super fresh, and the sushi is a hit with customers.

哎.note:
A sound to get someone's attention or show surprise, like "hey!" or "oh!": 哎，你去哪儿？
It starts the sentence and has no meaning of its own.

唉.note:
A sigh — regret, tiredness, giving in, like "oh well": 唉，又下雨了.
It starts the sentence and says how you feel, not what happened.

所.note:
Formal: before a verb, it makes "what is done": 我所知道的 = what I know.
Most often inside fixed words: 所以 = so, 所有 = all.
It also counts schools and houses: 一所学校 = a school.

木头.ex: 这张桌子是用木头做的。
木头.exen: This table is made of wood.

进步.ex: 坚持每天练口语，三个月后他的听力和表达都有明显进步。
进步.exen: By practicing speaking every day, his listening and speaking improved noticeably after three months.

合作.ex: 中德两国科学家合作研发新型太阳能电池，已申请国际专利。
合作.exen: Scientists from China and Germany worked together to develop a new type of solar cell and have applied for an international patent.

驾驶.ex: 拿到驾照后，他每天早八点驾驶电动车通勤上班。
驾驶.exen: After getting his driver’s license, he drives his electric car to work at eight every morning.

人民币.ex: 我在机场用美元兑换了五百元人民币。
人民币.exen: At the airport, I exchanged U.S. dollars for five hundred yuan in RMB.

晒.ex: 梅雨季结束，邻居们纷纷把被子搬出来晒。
晒.exen: When the plum rain season ends, the neighbors all bring their quilts outside to dry in the sun.

推荐.ex: 教授推荐我申请那所大学的奖学金。
推荐.exen: The professor recommended that I apply for that university’s scholarship.

文具.ex: 开学前，妈妈带他去文具店买了新书包和全套文具。
文具.exen: Before school started, his mother took him to the stationery store to buy a new backpack and a full set of stationery.

屋子.ex: 她租的屋子虽小，但采光很好。
屋子.exen: The room she rents is small but gets plenty of natural light.

象棋.ex: 社区老年中心每周三举办象棋友谊赛，冠军可获一盒手工茶点。
象棋.exen: The community senior center holds a friendly Chinese chess tournament every Wednesday, and the winner gets a box of handmade pastries.

项目.ex: 公司新启动的环保包装项目已进入测试阶段，预计下季度全面推广。
项目.exen: The company’s new eco-friendly packaging project has entered the testing phase and is expected to be fully rolled out next quarter.

业务.ex: 她刚接手市场部的新业务，每天都要和客户开会。
业务.exen: She has just taken over new work in the marketing department and has client meetings every day.

挣.ex: 他白天送外卖，晚上做代驾，拼命挣钱供妹妹读大学。
挣.exen: He delivers food by day and works as a designated driver at night, working hard to earn money to put his sister through university.

巴结.ex: 他频繁给主管送咖啡、主动加班替他改材料，同事私下笑他太会巴结。
巴结.exen: He is forever bringing the boss coffee and staying late to redo his documents; colleagues joke that he is a born flatterer.

层出不穷.ex: 短视频平台上，新奇的绘画挑战层出不穷，吸引大量年轻人参与。
层出不穷.exen: New drawing challenges keep appearing on short-video platforms, drawing in crowds of young people.

插座.ex: 酒店房间床头柜旁装了两个插座，方便旅客给手机和耳机充电。
插座.exen: Two sockets were fitted beside the bedside table so guests can charge a phone and headphones.

馋.ex: 闻到楼下面包店烤核桃面包的香气，她立刻馋得放下书冲下楼。
馋.exen: Smelling walnut bread from the bakery downstairs, she put down her book at once and rushed down.

尝试.ex: 她第一次尝试用人工智能工具辅助写作，虽然生疏但收获很大。
尝试.exen: It was her first attempt at writing with an artificial intelligence tool; clumsy, but she learned a lot.

雌雄.ex: 动物园新出生的两只熊猫幼崽经检测确认了雌雄，为科学饲养提供了依据。
雌雄.exen: Tests confirmed the sex of the zoo's two newborn panda cubs, giving keepers what they needed.

当面.ex: 关于薪资问题，人事经理坚持要当面沟通，而不是通过微信讨论。
当面.exen: On the matter of pay, the personnel manager insisted on talking face to face rather than over messages.

反馈.ex: 用户填写的问卷反馈帮助我们优化了手机应用的操作流程。
反馈.exen: The feedback from user questionnaires helped us streamline the app's flow.

钙.ex: 医生建议青春期学生每天摄入足量钙，以支持骨骼快速发育。
钙.exen: The doctor advised teenagers to take in enough calcium every day to support fast bone growth.

规范.ex: 新出台的人工智能伦理规范要求开发者公开算法的基本原理。
规范.exen: The new ethics code for artificial intelligence requires developers to disclose how their algorithms work.

基金.ex: 学校设立创新教育基金，资助学生开发环保主题的小程序。
基金.exen: The school set up an innovation fund to help students build environmental mini-programs.

居民.ex: 本小区居民可通过手机应用预约共享图书角和健身器材。
居民.exen: Residents here can book the shared reading corner and gym equipment through an app.

里程碑.ex: 公司自主研发的翻译引擎上线，被视为中国语言技术发展的重要里程碑。
里程碑.exen: The company's own translation engine going live is seen as a milestone for Chinese language technology.

举足轻重.ex: 这家芯片制造商在通信基站建设中举足轻重，供货进度直接影响项目交付。
举足轻重.exen: This chipmaker is decisive in building communication base stations, and its delivery pace drives the whole project.

瞄准.ex: 这家初创公司瞄准年轻人对心理健康服务的需求，开发了一款冥想软件。
瞄准.exen: The startup aimed at young people's need for mental-health support and built a meditation app.

模型.ex: 设计师用三维打印技术制作了新桥的模型。
模型.exen: The designer made a model of the new bridge with three-dimensional printing.

屏幕.ex: 医生把影像放大到诊断屏幕上，逐帧分析肺部的细微结构。
屏幕.exen: The doctor enlarged the scan on the diagnostic screen and went through the lung structures frame by frame.

任命.ex: 董事会刚刚任命一位有二十年国际经验的高管为新总裁。
任命.exen: The board has just appointed an executive with twenty years of international experience as its new president.

任意.ex: 公司禁止主管任意调整员工薪资，所有变动须经人事部门审核。
任意.exen: Managers may not adjust salaries at will; every change goes through the personnel department.

拾.ex: 孩子蹲下身，认真拾起散落在人行道上的几枚硬币。
拾.exen: The child crouched down and carefully picked up the coins scattered on the pavement.

识别.ex: 新系统已能准确识别不同品种的濒危兰花照片。
识别.exen: The new system can already tell apart photographs of different endangered orchid species.

通用.ex: 这款充电器的接口十分通用，笔记本、手机和耳机都能用它充电。
通用.exen: This charger's connector is universal, so laptops, phones and headphones all use it.

统统.ex: 系统升级后，旧版软件的所有功能统统无法使用，用户需立即更新。
统统.exen: After the upgrade none of the old software's features work at all, so users must update.

投机.ex: 他放弃长期研究方向，转而投机热门赛道，结果项目很快失去了资助。
投机.exen: He dropped his long-term research to speculate in a hot field, and the project soon lost its funding.

涂抹.ex: 孩子用荧光颜料在旧衣服上随意涂抹，意外做出一件亮眼的舞台服装。
涂抹.exen: The child daubed fluorescent paint over an old shirt and accidentally made a striking stage costume.

问世.ex: 这部融合人工智能技术的互动小说上月问世，引发读者广泛讨论。
问世.exen: This interactive novel built with artificial intelligence appeared last month and set readers talking.

误差.ex: 这台新型血糖仪的误差极小，远优于行业标准。
误差.exen: The margin of error on this new glucose meter is tiny, far better than the industry standard.

信念.ex: 无论创业失败几次，他都坚守“技术向善”的信念，最终做出了导航软件。
信念.exen: However often his ventures failed, he held to the belief that technology should do good, and eventually built a navigation app.

隐私.ex: 有些手机应用过度索取通讯录权限，引发用户对隐私泄露的普遍担忧。
隐私.exen: Some apps demand far more access to contacts than they need, worrying users about their privacy.

用户.ex: 这款翻译软件新增方言识别功能后，老年用户的使用率显著提升。
用户.exen: After dialect recognition was added, older users took to this translation software noticeably more.

运算.ex: 这个模型需要执行数万亿次浮点运算，才能完成一次图像识别。
运算.exen: The model has to run trillions of floating-point operations to recognise a single image.

扎实.ex: 他花了三年时间打下扎实的编程基础，后来顺利进入顶尖实验室。
扎实.exen: He spent three years building a solid grounding in programming and later joined a top laboratory.

战略.ex: 公司新任总裁上任后立即调整了全球市场战略，重点布局东南亚。
战略.exen: The new president revised the global market strategy on taking office, focusing on Southeast Asia.

自卑.ex: 他刚进新团队时因缺乏经验而自卑，主动请教几个月后建立了自信。

维生素.ex: 医生建议她每天补充维生素，尤其在冬季日照不足的时候。
维生素.exen: The doctor advised her to take vitamins every day, especially in winter when there is little sun.

纤维.ex: 棉布衣服舒适透气，因为天然棉纤维能快速吸湿并散发水汽。
纤维.exen: Cotton clothes are comfortable and breathable because natural cotton fibre wicks moisture away fast.

啦.note:
了 and 啊 run together: something has happened, said with feeling: 我到啦！= I'm here!
好啦 = all right, all right.
Casual and friendly — too light for formal writing.

嘛.note:
Says something is obvious, or should just be accepted: 他是孩子嘛 = he's only a kid, after all.
It also nudges a request: 快点嘛 = come on, hurry up.
It is not a question — that is 吗, which sounds almost the same.

立足.ex: 刚毕业的留学生需要先找到实习机会，才能在本地职场真正立足。
立足.exen: Newly graduated international students need to land an internship first before they can really establish themselves in the local job market.

粉色.ex: 她选了一条粉色连衣裙参加朋友的生日茶会。
粉色.exen: She picked a pink dress to wear to her friend's birthday tea party.

乞丐.ex: 地铁站出口常有几位乞丐安静地坐在角落，有人递去零钱，也有人礼貌地摇头走过。
乞丐.exen: Several beggars often sit quietly in the corners of the subway exit; some people hand them change, others politely shake their heads and walk past.

企图.ex: 监控录像显示，那人多次深夜徘徊在仓库附近，显然企图盗窃。
企图.exen: Surveillance footage showed the man loitering near the warehouse late at night several times, clearly intending to steal.

启程.ex: 我们原定周五启程去云南，但因暴雨导致航班取消，只好改期。
启程.exen: We had planned to set off for Yunnan on Friday, but heavy rain got our flight canceled, so we had to reschedule.

竖.ex: 孩子们在春节前一起竖起红灯笼，把院子装点得喜庆又明亮。
竖.exen: Before the Spring Festival, the children put up red lanterns together, making the courtyard festive and bright.

诬陷.ex: 监控录像最终证明他是被同事诬陷，才被暂停职务。
诬陷.exen: Surveillance footage finally proved that he had been framed by a colleague, which was why he had been suspended.

争气.ex: 他放弃高薪工作回乡教书，只为争气——让村里第一个大学生真正改变家乡。
争气.exen: He gave up a high-paying job to teach back home just to prove himself, so that the village's first college student could truly change his hometown.

壮烈.ex: 影片结尾的告别场面十分壮烈，让许多观众流下眼泪。
壮烈.exen: The farewell scene at the end of the film was heroic and tragic, bringing many viewers to tears.
